exams.notes: Passing qualifies examinee for engineer intern certificate; required as part of the path to professional engineer licensure.
exams.quote: Fundamentals of Engineering — The examination consists of a test on the fundamentals of engineering acceptable to the board. Passing this examination qualifies the examinee for an engineer intern certificate

exams.name: Principles and Practice of Engineering

exams.quote: Principles and Practice of Engineering — The professional engineering examination consists of a test on applied engineering acceptable to the board. Passing this examination qualifies the examinee for licensure as a professional engineer

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license from another jurisdiction and possess equivalent education, experience, and examination credentials. responsible_charge_defined.quote: "Responsible charge" means the control and direction of engineering work, or the control and direction of land surveying work, requiring initiative, professional skill, independent judgment and professional knowledge of the content of relevant documents during their preparation.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: The seal, signature and date shall be placed on all final specifications, land surveys, reports, plats, drawings, plans, design information and calculations whenever presented to a client or any public or governmental agency.

seal_document_types.quote: The seal, signature and date shall be placed on all final specifications, land surveys, reports, plats, drawings, plans, design information and calculations whenever presented to a client or any public or governmental agency.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: The practice of or offer to practice professional engineering or professional land surveying, as defined in this chapter, by professional engineers or professional land surveyors, through a business entity, or by a business entity through professional engineers or professional land surveyors, as employees, or officers, is permitted subject to the provisions of this chapter

value: The practice of any other profession or trade for which a license is required under any law of this state or the United States
Work of an employee or subordinate under direct supervision of a licensee not involving final engineering design or land surveying decisions
Teaching upper division engineering subjects at a college or university (existing as of July 1, 1988, or new employees for five years after hire)
Individual doing surveying work for himself on property owned or leased by the individual (except plats filed with county recorder for boundary purposes)
Individual doing survey work for mining claim location, amendment, or relocation
Practice of engineering by employees of a business entity for internal use only
Exceptional individuals with 12+ years of appropriate engineering experience (board discretion to waive fundamentals exam)
Applicant with bachelor's and doctorate in engineering from approved programs (exempt from fundamentals of engineering exam)
exemptions_from_licensure.quote: This chapter shall not be construed to affect: (a) The practice of any other profession or trade for which a license is required under any law of this state or the United States. (b) The work of an employee or a subordinate of a person holding a license under this chapter
